title: Deploying a Local Ghidra Server for Your Malware Analysis Lab, (Thu, Oct 29th)
content_md: Building your malware analysis lab is a key point before playing with malware. Today, thanks to virtualization, it’s convenient to play with snapshots in your lab. Start a new investigation from a clean snapshot and take some more when you reached a critical step. But, if you need to revert to a previous snapshot, all changes applied to the VM are… lost! Therefore, it’s important to store important data outside the VM. Article Link: Deploying a Local Ghidra Server for Your Malware Analysis Lab
exclude_reason: Tooling tutorial (Ghidra server setup); not a security event, vulnerability, or breach.
